semantic_audit.coverage_explanation: The documentation thoroughly covers all authored rules, conditions, tickets, and operational constraints from the evidence, including questionnaire versioning, experience and horizon classifications, loss tolerance validations, consent requirements, external integration with RiskSignal, idempotency, retry mechanisms, profile expiration, and reassessment continuity. It accurately reflects the status and uncertainties surrounding planned automatic reconciliation of orphan Mongo audits and properly notes the interpretive nature of the visual mockup descriptions.

assertions.statement: For INV-100, the current risk profile must be reviewed before starting a new draft and after recovery.
assertions.subject: Risk profiling draft journey
assertions.predicate: requires reviewing the current profile before starting a new draft and after recovery
assertions.conditions: ["A new draft is being started or recovery has occurred"]

assertions.statement: Q3 is the current questionnaire version, and a Q2 draft cannot be submitted after 2026-09-01.
assertions.subject: Questionnaire version
assertions.predicate: is Q3 as current, disallowing Q2 submissions after 2026-09-01
assertions.exceptions: ["A Q2 draft cannot be submitted after 2026-09-01"]

assertions.statement: Experience accepts NONE, BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, and ADVANCED, while EXPERT is retired and rejected.
assertions.subject: Experience level
assertions.predicate: accepts NONE, BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, and ADVANCED, and rejects EXPERT

assertions.statement: Month 36 starts horizon H3, whereas Month 35 remains H1.
assertions.subject: Investment horizon
assertions.predicate: maps Month 36 to H3 and Month 35 to H1

assertions.statement: Exactly 5 percent belongs to L5, and a 5.1 percent free-text answer is invalid.
assertions.subject: Loss tolerance
assertions.predicate: assigns exactly 5 percent to L5 and rejects 5.1 percent as invalid

assertions.statement: PROFILE_PROCESSING consent at CP-3 is required for submission; marketing consent alone never permits submission.
assertions.subject: Profile submission consent

assertions.statement: RiskSignal is the only external business provider called by risk profiling, sharing a correlation ID with the platform, while MarketPulse and CustodyBridge are unrelated to profile submission and no provider call occurs for an incomplete draft.
assertions.subject: RiskSignal external integration
assertions.predicate: is the sole external provider called by risk profiling, sharing a correlation ID with the platform, and is not called for incomplete drafts
assertions.exceptions: ["No provider call occurs for an incomplete draft"]

assertions.statement: A complete Q3 submission uses one stable idempotency key, and a duplicate submission with identical answers returns the stored result.
assertions.subject: Q3 submission idempotency
assertions.predicate: uses a stable idempotency key returning the stored result for duplicate answers

assertions.statement: An incomplete RiskSignal response cannot become an accepted profile, and a missing reason code keeps the draft recoverable.
assertions.subject: RiskSignal response validation
assertions.predicate: rejects incomplete responses from becoming accepted profiles while keeping drafts recoverable when reason codes are missing
assertions.exceptions: ["A missing reason code keeps the draft recoverable"]

assertions.statement: A failed reassessment leaves the prior unexpired profile active until its original expiry and does not constitute a new active profile.
assertions.subject: Risk profile reassessment
assertions.predicate: maintains the prior unexpired profile active until its original expiry upon reassessment failure

assertions.statement: A risk profile result expires 365 days after acceptance and remains visible in history after expiry.
assertions.subject: Risk profile lifecycle
assertions.predicate: expires 365 days after acceptance while remaining visible in history

assertions.statement: An orphan Mongo audit record requires a human review decision; automatic reconciliation is planned and not implemented.
assertions.subject: Orphan Mongo audit
assertions.predicate: requires a human review decision while automatic reconciliation remains planned and unimplemented

assertions.statement: The assessment-result view mockup illustrates an accepted risk profile display showing Band R2 · Measured, Rules RS-2026-09, Reasons: HORIZON_3, LOSS_5, Accepted 2026-10-01 UTC, and Review after 365 days under Accepted profile P-204.
assertions.subject: Assessment result mockup
assertions.predicate: depicts accepted profile P-204 with band, rules version, reason codes, acceptance timestamp, and review duration

assertions.subject: Questionnaire mockup
